patient._comment: 'patient' contains player-visible patient data and explanatory triage reasoning for Coach and review.

clinical.quoteLong: Was cleaning my own gun — don't tell my wife. Bleeding's basically stopped though. It's not that bad... right?
clinical.presentationShort: 41yo M — single GSW to upper arm, bleeding controlled, distal pulse & sensation intact.
clinical.presentationLong: 41-year-old male, single gunshot wound to the upper arm, bleeding controlled with direct pressure, distal pulse and sensation intact.

triageReasoning.summary: This is a high-risk penetrating extremity injury that may conceal vascular, nerve, bone, or deeper tissue damage.
triageReasoning.acuityReason: Controlled external bleeding and an intact distal pulse do not eliminate the risk created by a gunshot mechanism, and the patient reports severe pain.
triageReasoning.destinationReason: ESI 2 / Acute is appropriate because the penetrating mechanism creates a high-risk presentation even though the patient is currently alert and hemodynamically stable.
keyFindings: Gunshot wound to the upper arm
Small blood spot visible on the covering towel
redFlags: Potential occult vascular or nerve injury
Potential fracture or retained foreign material
teachingPoints: A small wound or temporarily controlled bleeding does not make a gunshot injury low acuity.
Mechanism and the possibility of concealed damage are central to the triage decision.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: The patient would likely receive imaging, repeated neurovascular examinations, wound and tetanus care, pain treatment, and specialty consultation if deeper injury is suspected.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting, pressing a folded hand-towel firmly over his upper arm with his opposite hand
aiImageGeneration.expression: teeth gritted, grimacing, pale and anxious
signs: folded towel held firmly over the upper arm — wound covered
small blood spot soaked into the towel, no dripping, no pool

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a Hispanic 41-year-old man in a plaid button-up shirt with one sleeve torn and rolled up at the upper arm, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting, pressing a folded hand-towel firmly over his upper arm with his opposite hand. Expression: gritted teeth, grimacing, pale and anxious.
